description: AC-2v2/AC-4 golden scenario for the exit-friction subtraction, shared across all three replay exit-accounting sites (_collect_sim_returns, _collect_sim_returns_dated, run_simulation). Expected objective values are DERIVED in-test from these raw inputs via the documented formula, never hardcoded (house test rule).

single_tick_day.description: Minimal one-tick day: trigger tick == eod tick. Used to pin the core friction-subtraction delta in isolation (no missed-upside/drawdown penalty complications in run_simulation).

friction_exceeds_gain_day.description: Two-tick day engineered so the trigger fires on tick 0 (return 5.0, deviation penalty 0.0 for this scenario) while the EOD tick (tick 1, return 4.7) is different -- guard_alpha is POSITIVE without friction (+0.3) and must flip NEGATIVE with the real friction constant (0.5 > 0.3), flowing through unclamped (plan Edge Case).
